كَوْمَحٌ (and كُومَحٌ, L) A man (S) having large buttocks. (S, L, K.) ―
-b2- Also كَوْمَحٌ, A man (TA) whose teeth fill his mouth so that his speech is thick: (K:) or a man whose teeth are crowded together, one upon another, so that his mouth seems to be straitened by them. (IDrd.) ―
-b3- فَمٌ كومح A mouth straitened by the great number of the teeth and by the swelling of the gums. (IDrd.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
